steps.name: Loken
steps.text: A lot of noise. Another delivery from your Engineering Director?

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: Final tests will take about forty-five minutes.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Plenty.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: My greatest achievement will be complete once this data is transferred.

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: I will retain your research records.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I know. Give it to that girl, Ho'olheyak, or someone else... I don't care.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Being able to finish this research here in my final days almost lets me forget all the regrets in my life.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Haha... *cough*.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I still remember how hard it was to accept when you showed this to me for the first time.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: ...hehe.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Hahaha... *cough*, *cough*...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: The irony. How it scorns every conceited researcher who walked the halls of science for the past few centuries.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: It laughs in the face of our research, made all it worthless...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: What is this, Kristen?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: How are you able to speak of its theories and emerge with such confidence, when you've never performed a single experiment?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: This thing... it's beyond my understanding. Even more frightening is that all those tales you tell of these black cubes are true.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Tell me, Kristen.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Tell me! What is this that I am about to study?!

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: That's your job.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Where did you find it? How did you gain this knowledge?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Don't be so hard on a dying man, Kristen.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Who gave you this?

steps.name: Kristen
steps.text: ...God.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Have I overestimated you, young genius? Do you believe in ghosts and spirits, look up to the unknown in awe?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: No, you're not the kind of woman who would joke about this. You're not foolish or shameless enough for that, or to place your hopes in empty faith.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: I'll take your word for it... hmph. The irony.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: 'God.'

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Another month has passed since 'God' bestowed on me his mercy.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: In this short period of time, I completed more work than I could have imagined for decades.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Hmph. Even I can't help but wonder...

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: What 'miracle' do you plan to bring us... bring to the people on his land?
Kristen does not answer.
She gazes at the stars outside the window silently, lost in thought.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Another half an hour... bah, I should start thinking about supper.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Donut? Fried fowlbeast? Hot dog?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: All of Trimounts is up in arms over this place, but look how carefree the heart of the storm is.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: *cough* Wh-Who are you?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I want the blueprints and efficiency data for the S.H.A.F.T. and the associated facilities, now.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: S-Sir, that's highly classified...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Do you see my clothes? My security pass right here? Or do you need me to put Blake on the line for you?

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: N-No, sir, I'll put it together...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No need. This terminal right here. Turn it on.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: But sir, this is raw data without visualization...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: ...I'm Ferdinand Clooney.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Rhine Lab's Director of Energy.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I designed the Trimountian energy circulation system. The processor of the terminal in front of you is based on an Originium energy conversion formula named after me.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: The Clooney... Formula?! Y-You're...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You've wasted two minutes. Data, now.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Y-Yes, sir!
Seconds pass, then minutes.
Ferdinand could almost hear the sounds of military convoys moving through the streets. Blake could find Kristen any moment.
He must hurry... for what?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Here, and here.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Have these data been manipulated?

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: O-Of course not! All the data are transmitted in real-time to the army's labs! It's more than my life's worth to upload false data!

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: No one wants to get on the wrong side of the army...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: It doesn't match.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: I beg your pardon?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: The structure of the S.H.A.F.T., the distribution of the pipelines and the performance of the existing propulsion system. None of them is right.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Just discreet enough to avoid notice... damn.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: That can't be, you must be mista—no, I suppose not, you of all people.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Perhaps this is a temporary plan for experimentation and development, and adjustment will be made before the official launch.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: What's the plan for the official launch?

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: H.A.M.H.R.R. should be on a mobile plate near the S.H.A.F.T.. Kristen stole the entire plate.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: But the propulsion device is still here! The army has impounded all the launchers that were under construction!

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Even if she manipulated the data, she couldn't... not with this propulsion performance...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Unless...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Get Blake on the line.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Now.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: This had better be important, Ferdinand, for you to bother me at a time like this.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Listen. Nasti Lunorey is one of Kristen's. The propulsion device that she designed does not have the performance to lift H.A.M.H.R.R. off the ground.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Justin Jr. must have bought out your scientists to cover up Kristen's real goal. They're working together.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: So you're telling me everyone in Rhine Lab is complicit in Kristen's suspected treason.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I'm not...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: You need to tell me something new.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: If the researcher you sent me is actually useful, then I'll drag that Control of yours from the stolen H.A.M.H.R.R. soon enough.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Which is to say, I will soon know how many insurgents there are in Rhine.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Then Rhine...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Is there anything more important that you want to report?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No, sir.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Congratulations in advance on your successful mission, Colonel.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Close the file.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Yes, sir... is there anything else you need?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Do you have a maintenance aircraft? The kind that can reach H.A.M.H.R.R.'s theoretical ceiling?

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Yes, we do!

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I need to borrow it.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: But didn't you say H.A.M.H.R.R. wouldn't fly because of propulsion issues?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Or... can it?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: (Whisper) You're right. We took our first steps together.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I mean, you're right. Maybe I was mistaken.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Strong Transmitter reaction. I can feel a lot of it lying ahead.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Right in the middle of urban Trimounts.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir. The area ahead is sewage treatment and garbage disposal. Very few people live here.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: You mean Kristen Wright hid H.A.M.H.R.R. in some other building, right under our nose.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Target may have set up jammers in the area. Our guys didn't detect any signals when they passed through.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Those egghead sons of bitches and their tricks.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Should we turn the place upside-down?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: No, that'll take too much time, and draw the enemy's attention.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Can you locate it?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I need to borrow your neural-electricity stimulator.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Do you know how to use that?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I believe Rhine developed it.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: There's no getting away from you people, is there? Give it to her.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Cranial-electricity will trigger resonance in the Transmitter inside me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Resonance will also occur in any nearby Transmitter, strong enough for your sensors to detect.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: I-I got a reading! It's increasing in strength!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Increase output by ten percent.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Urgh... nngh...

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Pre-epilepsy symptom! Should I take over? I have mech operating experience and long-range Arts Unit implants.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Her Transmitter is from Site 359. It's the only one that will work.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Pro... proceed.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I can take it.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: We got a stable signal!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Coordinates have been synchronized to officer terminals, sir.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Good, we know where H.A.M.H.R.R. is now.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Proceed to the target ASAP!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ngh... guh...

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Handkerchief. Doubt you can even see through all that sweat.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Th-Thank you...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Director Jara... did the soldiers bother you?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Oh? No, just usual chit-chat.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Did you... say anything?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: ...Nothing.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: The funny thing is, I don't even know anything. I know Kristen like Kristen knows me.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I didn't sign on to her adventure, and she refused to let me risk my remaining life for her.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Control is lucky to have you.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Lucky?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: No, I don't think so, Silence.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: When I look at Kristen, I don't see the inscrutable, dominating Control of Rhine... I only see a girl too proud to bow her head.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Maybe time stopped twenty years ago for both of us.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You mean... the day when Control's parents were killed in a flight test accident?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: It was supposed to be a sunny, cloudless day.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Is it regret? Remorse?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Is it because I watched them fly to their end, because I didn't check their flight plan carefully—

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Or because I didn't expect the government and capitalists would allow that sensitive little girl to become the target of all the attacks on her parents, in order to protect their name?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: No, it's neither.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: It was just one failure. Even if it was my only one, it should be nothing for an experienced agent.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: But I could never forget the look in her eyes. That ball of fire falling from the sky continues to burn in her eyes.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: It's appeared in my dreams on many a night.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I don't want to see it extinguished again.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: You left the Maylander Foundation because of Control.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: A scientist stops being a scientist when she develops an emotional attachment to her test subject, huh?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: You, of all people, should understand.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I was never a mother.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: But I have a child.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Gamma and Delta Squads in position, sir.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Everything looks normal with the target building. Scanning for potential hostiles...

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Wait, is that... a Maylander drone!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: So that's why the goddamned agents didn't show up. They were tracking our aircraft!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Why didn't they find out about the plate, then? Were they waiting for us to do our job, then pick up the scraps?

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Maylander's eyes are everywhere.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Columbia has changed a lot in the past twenty years.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I used to protect people like the Wrights from conspiracy theorists and technophobes.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: I suppose even the great Maylander can be wrong at times.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Look at the mad scientists out there, they're the greatest threat.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Message from Maylander, Colonel.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: They're syncing the drone's data with us. Less than ten lifeforms within ten klicks of the target.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: We had an elite squad keeping an eye on Kristen before she disappeared.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Are you telling me that a bunch of scientists and a few assistants took out an entire squad of commandos?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Maybe we went to the wrong place?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: That's not impossible for the Control I know...

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Keep your eyes open. Don't let your guard d—

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: What was that?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: I think we just hit something, sir!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: No, sensors aren't picking up anything.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: I-It's wind! It's a wall of wind!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: We can't maintain attitude!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Losing altitude! 500, 400, 350—

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Out of my way! Give me the controls!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Th-That's the building's outer wall! We're gonna hit it!
First one.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: What happened?!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: That's the Colonel's aircraft! It fell into the buildings at 10 o'clock—Gamma Squad to the crash site, now!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Did the enemy come from the air? Why didn't we get any warnings from the Maylander drones?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: No, we've lost all communications.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Maylander's eyes all went out at the same time?
Second one.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Total loss of communications with Maylander? This is FUBAR, isn't their shit supposed to be cutting-edge?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Large number of hostiles! Ten, eleven—no, more!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Ambush! Raise the Colonel!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: There's too many of them!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Hold! Hold!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: The Maylander douchebags said there were less than ten! Was the data wrong, or did they screw us?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Agh—!

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: It's not the data that's wrong.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: Colonel! You're safe!

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Form up.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Gamma and Delta, pull back and find cover. Have the power armor assault team move up.

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: Let everyone know—

steps.name: Blake
steps.text: We're facing the latest prototype unmanned power armor.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Third one.
The walls of the room block all screams, but the explosions can be clearly seen on the monitors.
Ho'olheyak does not look at the screen. Her eyes have not left the book since the first prey stepped into the trap.
She swings her tail back and forth in boredom, pressing one button after another, directing the show happening not far from here.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: To fulfill my final wish.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Sneaking out to meet someone again? You'll die out there, and I won't be there to save you.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...... *cough* *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Don't croak before the work is done.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Otherwise—

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You can't take it from me.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: It's not ready for activation yet. Only an ugly death awaits if you *cough* rush it.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I know. I've heard that enough times.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: Take it as words of wisdom from a dying man.

steps.name: Loken
steps.text: You're too young to be showing the madness of the impeding end.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Time does not treat us all fairly. Go, old man, and dream your last dream before death carries you away.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Good night.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: As for me... it's time for me to deal with my last problem.
Ho'olheyak puts down the book and hooks something from the pile of books with her tail.
A metal head.
She blows lightly at the head and sees the white vapor pass through the metal shell, then dissipate into thin air without going anywhere.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: It's not everyday that you get to see Maylander agents work with commandos.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Are you really sure you don't want to come back from the dead, my dear old employer?

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: You'll miss the best parts.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: *cough* *cough* Who's the enemy?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Only someone with the internal access codes can disable all of Maylander's eyes at the same time.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Control has someone from Maylander with her?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: An elite Maylander agent, codename Ho'olheyak. She took over the task of monitoring Kristen from me. I wasn't sure if she had turned traitor... until now.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ho'olheyak?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Yesterday.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Ho'olheyak means 'yesterday.' It's unknown whether it's her codename or the one she was born with.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Kristen brought her to Rhine Lab one year ago, saying she was Rhine Lab's new bibliology consultant.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: I looked into her background but found nothing.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Maylander had concealed most of her files, of course, but that wasn't much of a problem for me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Not even Maylander knows about her past?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: It's like she popped into the world yesterday. Her knowledge, her powers, her Arts... none of them have anything to do with modern technology.

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: Have you ever heard the legend, from the days when the world was just a barren land?

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: 'She is Liberi, she is Phidia.'

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: 'She rides with the wind and dances with the stars.'

steps.name: Jara
steps.text: 'She is the last Elder still blessed by the heavens.'

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Forward, forward!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Stay in formation! Cover the others!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Wait, up in the sky—hostile approaching!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Take aim!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Energy beam... wait, how could this be? It won't fire—are our weapons being attacked?

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: No, the weapon's fine—it's the sky that's being affected!

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Unknown energy interference in the area—

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: Argh!
A great force takes hold of him.
Even in his metal armor, the soldier feels frail and helpless, like a naked infant.
He waves his limbs futilely, but he could not control his body, or the exoskeleton wrapped around it.
He is flung like a plastic toy, smashing into another power armor.
Silver-green shadows leave the shattered armor.
A silhouette approaches slowly in the smoke.

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: G212α-13 abandoning exoskeleton! Hostile contact, s-support requested—

steps.name: Power Armor Operator
steps.text: How many hostiles?

steps.name: Columbian Soldier
steps.text: O-One...

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: ...One.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: I'm afraid I'm the only one you're facing.

steps.name: Ho'olheyak
steps.text: Do you need time to surrender?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Mm... we're almost there.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's the hideout Kristen prepared for Loken.

options: We walked a few hours underground.
I thought the end of the passage would look more normal.
Where did you get your info, Muelsyse?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I befriended a... er, straightforward engineer.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Whew... I've smelled better.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Kristen hasn't changed. You could throw her into a garbage dump when she's in the middle of an experiment, and she wouldn't care one bit.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Did you know that Saria and I picked all her clothes? Even Saria is more concerned about fashion than she is. And...

options: Did the army find the place?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Drat, we don't have time!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Doctor... Loken is a convict with a few hundred years on his sentence. You want to take Rosmontis to see him? Then you have to beat them to it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: How do you plan to explain to the military if they find us together?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: What's with the kitten? Is she thinking about something?

options: I think she's sensitive to the battlefield environment.
There's something interfering with her thoughts.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Keep an eye on her, Doctor. I need to find a way in... maybe I can use my water to get in through the vents, then hack the door circuits...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Loken.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I remember this place.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's not in my memory. I've never been in this corridor. But my eyes, ears, mouth, emotions... they all tell me that I've walked a path like it.

a.text: Welcome home, child. Welcome to the court that I prepared for you.
